title: Flatness on a union of finite locally free loci
statement: Let T be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], M an O_T-module, and U a family of open subsets indexed by an arbitrary type. Assume that for each index a the ordinary restriction [def-pc-module-pullback] M|U(a) is finite locally free of some natural rank r(a) [def-pc-finite-locally-free]. Then M restricted to the union of U(a) is flat [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules]. No uniform rank, finite covering, or nonemptiness hypothesis is required.

source.place: Proof, third paragraph: identify E on the open locus through its cohomology sheaf; first step of lem-pc-derived-pullback-single-cohomology

proof.text: Put W = the union of U(a) and N = M restricted to W. For each point x of W, choose a(x) with x in U(a(x)), and let f(x): U(a(x)) -> W be Scheme.homOfLE. Its open range contains x, so these open immersions cover W. This reindexes the cover by W:Type u, even when the original index type lies in an arbitrary universe. Empty W has an empty covering.

Each M restricted to U(a(x)) is finite locally free with the rank forgotten. The restriction-composition isomorphism and restrictFunctorIsoPullback identify it with f(x)^* N. Apply the already proved source theorem AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.isFiniteLocallyFree_of_isOpenImmersion (WeilConjectures.AlgebraicGeometry.Modules.FiniteDescent) to conclude that N is finite locally free with varying rank. This theorem glues finite free trivializations and imposes no common rank.

Apply finiteLocallyFree_tensorLeft_exact, the declaration of lem-sc-ext-tensor-exact, to N. Transport both finite-limit and finite-colimit preservation from tensorLeft N to tensorRight N via BraidedCategory.tensorLeftIsoTensorRight N. The resulting pair is definitionally SheafOfModules.IsFlat N.

proof_origin.place: Point-indexed covering and existing finite-local-freeness descent, followed by finiteLocallyFree_tensorLeft_exact and braided tensor comparison (2026-10-12).
